children: RNS Number : 3148U  Rockwood Strategic PLC  11 September 2026

On 10 September 2026, the Company agreed to issue 50,000 ordinary shares of 5 pence each at a price of 313.97 pence per share from its blocklisting facility. The shares will be issued for cash on 14th September 2026.

On 14th September 2026, the Company's issued share capital will consist of 62,443,760 ordinary shares and there are no shares held in treasury. Therefore, the total number of voting rights in the Company will be 62,443,760.

The above figure may be used by shareholders as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest, or a change to their interest, in the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
